title: podocarpus henkelii subsp. ensiculus
intro: Podocarpus henkelii subsp. ensiculus, commonly known as the Eastern Cape Yellowwood, is a plant species within the family Podocarpaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may help in reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids have been isolated from the plant, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
